game_name: Tomb Raider Game of the Year

verdict.tagline: Thrilling cinematic adventure, despite technical and control friction.
for_you_if: you want a cinematic action adventure
you can overlook messy narrative beats
not_for_you_if: you are prone to motion sickness from camera shake
you need stable performance without crashes

distortion_flags.sentence: Approval ratings increase significantly as players advance past the opening hours.

cohorts.label: <2h refund window
cohorts.summary: Early reviewers encounter severe crashes and heavy camera movement that triggers motion sickness.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game features heavy camera shake and sway that can induce motion sickness, with no accessibility options to reduce or turn it off.

citations.review_text:
For someone who rarely gets motion sickness, the camera shake was so  excessive and dizzying, it was unplayable, even for me. There are no accessibility options to reduce or turn it off.

Also, the majority of what I did play in the first hour was mostly set pieces, with more QTEs than a Quantic Dream game.
SOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO BAD FOR MOTION SICKNESS IT IS UNREAL, I ALMOST THREW UP AFTER AROUND 10 MINUTES

not only are there microstutters & game hiccups, but it has the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ camera shake and sway I've ever encountered. they are trying to make it so soooo soooo cinematic that it just causes motion sickness. like let me walk without freaking jutting the camera every step. And then the bright white flashing lights. And it runs like buttholes always freezing here and there during the cutscenes and cinematic camera action shots. And yes, i tried the fixes listed online, but like they don't completely solve the issues, and when you are sensitive to this stuff, it's totally obvious. anyways, i got 10% thru, and I'm just gonna uninstall it before I press and get sick again.

DO NOT BUY THIS GAME!!
There is a massive camera shake/wobble that causes nausea and headaches for people and there is no option to turn it off.

claims.claim: Reviewers report encountering bugs and glitches that can softlock progression, requiring a restart.

citations.review_text:
I remember playing this game back when it came out, actually a great game and holds up very well for it's age, considering it's 13 years old from when it released to me playing it again.

The graphics are good, gameplay is fun and finding the documents, relics and additional tombs are engaging to find them all at least for me, I wanted to find all of them even if the GPS caches were hard in some areas to see!

I can't really fault the game, other than the fact it's too short, you can complete this game if you focus on story in around 12 hours maybe even less if you're optimised. The length does work well for the story and game but it left me wanting a bit more out of it really. The multiplayer is dead so don't go looking for that experience but you can find groups of people looking to play with others for achievements and such. 

I will warn people reading this however to be aware that this game can lock you once you reach Geothermal Caverns, there is a crate that you need to move by igniting gas to explode. If you do this with VYSYNC OFF, it will break the game and if you don't have another checkpoint you will have to restart the whole game or use cheats to bypass, so just make sure you have that ON so you also don't run into this issue. Have a quick google and look at many others including myself that ran into this issue so be careful!

All in all, highly recommend and looking forward to playing the rest of the trilogy.

9/10

Dont waste ur time on this game, its 2026 and its still full of bugs.
Most are not gamebreaking, enemies floating and bouncing etc.

But there are also bugs that make it so you cannot progress any further, and have to start over from scratch.
For me and many others ( see forum ) theres a box on a level called Geothermal caverns that doesnt go where it should and u have to replay the first 35% of the game to get back there, or download savefiles from some fan site to load into the game further ahead etc.

F U C K This game.

This game is full of bugs and glitches, some of which are completely game breaking. I'm currently softlocked in the Geothermal Caverns and have tried everything to be able to progress, but nothing has worked so I have no choice but to abandon this game. Besides that, the options menu is seriously lacking. For some awful reason the sound effects and voice volume seem to be the same level, the sound effects are deafening loud and there's absolutely NO audio options. You can't turn off the camera wobble when Lara is walking or running so there's constant camera movement, including every single cutscene. If you are prone to motion sickness, God help you because it is atrocious. 

Also, the controls for mouse & keyboard are so bad!! I do recommend playing with a controller if you are able to. However I prefer to use my PS4 controller and this game does not accept that so there's no Playstation prompts, and there are currently no mods (I couldn't find any anyways) that exist to help with that. So I was forced to use mouse and keyboard, the quick time events are horrible as they have stupid little icons show up for half a second and sometimes you have to press up to 3 different buttons to get through a scene. You will most certainly die during every QTE because you don't know which button to press. All in all I would NOT suggest anyone play this, look at other negative reviews and you'll see they all say the same things about this game. I really was hoping I would enjoy this game but I just cannot get through it, literally as the game is completely bugged for me. I'm hoping the sequels are better!

claims.claim: Reviewers report that the game lacks an option to disable camera shake and wobble.

citations.review_text: how this garbage is rated overwhelmingly positive is beyond me, where do i begin with this slop. Starting with the awful camera shake that you cant turn off, its actually unreasonably bad even when moving as slow as possible. the controls feel clunky and half baked, every animation seems half animated like they couldn't be bothered to make it smooth. the gameplay is boring to say the least, running and shooting clunkily with basic mechanics that don't feel rewarding with annoying climbing sections that don't flow at all. The "puzzles" and "tombs" are completely pointless that give no real reward and just feel like a slap in the face to be even included like it was something special. action sequences are awful and laura just ends up flopping around like a fish with no rhyme or reason while random Michael bay explosions flash around the screen with no actual origin where they came from,  The ''hunting" mechanic is completely useless and serves no purpose after its introduction and really just encourages you to indiscriminately murder every animal you see for no real reason other than XP. the abilities you get with the xp is hardly useful as you can easily finish the laughably easy game without leveling anything. The plot is extremely base level and uninspired, the graphics are okay for the time period and the voice acting is terrible with very forgettable characters that i already forgot about after finishing so its hard to even speak about them. the level design seems hastily thrown together, just feels like random assets stapled together with no thought, I've seen far better design in indie games. Honestly seems like they wanted to make their own Uncharted 2 which they were hilariously far from. bought during an extreme discount and its still not worth it

claims.claim: Reviewers state that the tombs are brief, few in number, and offer minimal challenge.

citations.review_text:
Great game to open up the trilogy. Gameplay is fun and visuals still hold up great. Controls are simple to use out of the box and the different weapons give you different ways to play. The Tombs and Challenges felt a bit short but as a reboot that was probably for the best.
Played the entire game on my Steam Deck OLED and aside from a couple large areas, it ran well at 45 refresh.

This game is genuinely one of the most fun action story games I've ever played. Lara Croft is a beautiful character and her arc throughout the game is extremely compelling. The gameplay itself is spectacular. Although I struggled with some bugs while playing, it was mostly very smooth. The action was not as polished as I would have liked but I enjoyed the unique finishers and the option given for stealth. The choice between stealth and head on action was really nice as well. It offers something for everyone, if you prefer to act in the shadows, you'll enjoy the stealth. If you prefer to go in and fight, you can make that decision. The brotherhood was genuinely terrifying at times and provided an element of horror I hadn't anticipated, which was very much welcomed. The graphics were not the greatest we've seen from this trilogy, however they had their own unique charm to them. Everything in the game was glowing and made the game look amazing. The only other complaint I could make was that the tombs were not very challenging and there weren't many tombs. Seeing as this was a Tomb Raider game, it was disappointing that they did not emphasize this aspect as it is so intrinsic to Lara's character. I would've liked more of a challenge in the tombs since I enjoy puzzles, but if you don't enjoy puzzles as much, then you'll enjoy this aspect more. Overall, I loved the characters and the emotional aspect of the story and would recommend to anyone looking to get into Tomb Raider!

claims.claim: Reviewers state that multiplayer achievements are difficult or impossible to complete because the multiplayer mode is completely dead.

citations.review_text: For my computer it was a bit laggy and slow, but i still loved the game. I completed it 2 times, and I want to play it again. I got this game while there was a sale and dont regret it. This game is adventurous and has all kinds of different challenges to complete, theres a lot of shooting too. I loved the main character Lara and I recommend this game. Im trying to achieve all of the achievements but its hard when some of them are in multiplayer while a very small ammount of people or none at all play at times.

This isn't your dad's Lara Croft. This game came out over a decade ago. So it might be your dad's Croft now.

Tomb Raider was sort of a dead franchise when this game came out. The blunders of games rushed by executives drizzled out the thunder of the earlier entries. Then came a Lara drought. Then came a reboot.

Turns out this game is not really a reboot. It's more like a prequel. Thirteen years later and Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis was announced. All of the events of the Survivor trilogy (2013, Rise, and Shadow) remain canon. It is also re-telling the story of Tomb Raider's original 90's release.

That frames this game as the start of the legend. This is Lara's first big girl adventure. One with stakes. And it shows us how Lara becomes the professional killer in her later years. Already with this game she is scrapping to survive. One of the mechanics is literally throwing dirt in your opponent's face. I like how the gameplay characterizes Lara in a very different way than what people were used to for her. I do not think it is better or worse. It's just new.

The game is not perfect. If you're like me and you're sort of achievement-crazy, this game has multiplayer achievements. The multiplayer is completely dead. The grind to get one of the achievements is easily a mind-numbing fifteen hours. Do yourself a favor and just download Steam Achievement Manager and check the boxes for the multiplayer achievements instead. I regret not doing this myself.

Apart from the multiplayer stuff. A lot of the platforming feels unreliable. There are lots of times I felt I jumped onto a zipline rope and Lara just decided not to slide down it and go careening into the abyss instead. The game overall feels a bit janky. Mostly because this was designed with a controller in mind. I care too much about good aim to swap to my controller to play this one. A lot of the characters in this one are pretty forgettable. Jonah does appear in future installments and overall he probably is the…
I would like to say only one thing about the game which is "SCREW THE MULTIPLAYER ACHIEVEMENTS".

Tomb Raider is one of the best reboots ever made, mainly because of how well it develops Lara Croft from a vulnerable and inexperienced survivor into a strong and determined character. The lore surrounding Yamatai Island is incredibly immersive, mixing mystery, survival, and supernatural elements in a way that keeps the story engaging throughout the entire game. The gameplay also stays fresh thanks to its variety of combat, exploration, stealth, platforming, and cinematic interactive moments that make the experience feel intense and memorable. However, the biggest downside comes from the achievements, especially frustrating ones like “Chatterbox,” which can easily be missed and force unnecessary replaying, along with the multiplayer achievements tied to a mode that is now practically dead..

claims.claim: Reviewers note that optional tombs feature brief physics puzzles that are relatively simple and straightforward.

citations.review_text:
Boob Raider, pardon. Tomb Raider serisinin, en güzel memele.. şeyi oyunu harbiden.

Eski oyun oynamanın en büyük zorluğu mekanikler ve oynanış sıkıcı olur. Oyun yavan gelir böyle bazen kendinizi zorlayarak oynarsınız ama bu oyun öyle güzel yaşlanmış ki; o aksiyon ve adrenalini sizi hiç sıkmadan, harbiden hissettiriyor. Kendini merakla oynatıyor.

2013 yılının oyunu olmasına rağmen grafiklerde, aksiyonda, müzikte, atmosferde ve hikayede 2026 oyunlarının çoğunu açık ara tokatlar. Cutscenelerden aksiyon sahnelerine, hikayesinden müziklerine kadar her şey o kadar iyi ki, bir sonraki sahneyi sabırsızlıkla bekliyorsunuz. Hiç sıkılmıyorsunuz.

Serinin diğer oyunlarında loot, keşfetme, çatışma ve açık dünya fazlayken; bunda cutscene ve aksiyon o kadar fazla ki, aksiyon sürekli tırmanıyor ve film izliyor gibi hissediyorsunuz. Serinin de en karanlık oyunu ayrıca; kan ve ceset dolu havuzlarda yüzmekten, cesetlerin asılmış olduğu mağaralara kadar sizi aklınıza gelmeyecek yerlere sokuyor.

Kötü şeyler yok mu? var. Save sistemi aşırı kötü mesela ve hikayenin bazı bölümleri mantıksız. Bir de hesapta zor tasarlanmış Tomb bölümleri var. Buralarda puzzle çözüp, tomb keşfediyosunuz güya ama aşırı kötü. O kadar basit ki puzzle dedikleri şeyler, çocuk çözer. Onun dışında bug veya başka kötü bir şey görmedim.

Save sistemi haritada bulunduğunuz bir noktaya göre save aldığı için bir mekana girdiniz ve orada yürüye yürüye gidip, çatışırken öldünüz diyelim. Oyun sizi, o mekanı temizlemişsiniz gibi başlatıyor çünkü save aldığı noktaya yürümüşüm ve oyun temizledim de yürüdüm sanıyor. Saçma çünkü yeniden başlattığında orada ki tüm düşmanlar gittiği için loot da gidiyor. 

Tekrar oynamak istediğiniz bir sahneyi ve bölümü kolayca oynayamıyorsunuz. Çok güzel aksiyon olan bir yeri veya sahneyi, bir daha oynamak istiyorsunuz mesela ama yapamıyorsunuz. Sizi sürekli sahneden sonra başlatıyor. O yüzden sık sık, auto save dışında save alın.

Hikaye ise genel olarak çok güzel ama mantıksız…

Came for the tomb raiding, stayed for the pure chaos of taking down an entire cult solo. upgrading weapons at base camps makes your progression feel super rewarding as you go. traversal and climbing feel super smooth and responsive from start to finish. secret tombs are a bit brief but still offer really fun physics puzzles. holds up amazingly well for a 2013 game and is 100% worth buying, 9/10

citations.review_text:
Great game, great adventure, great story. It's Indiana Jones, crossed with Nathan Drake, pacakaged as an introduction to the woman who would go on to become the famed explorer: Lara Croft. Gameplay is smooth, visuals are atmospheric, with swelling music and some touching scenes.

Overall a very good and polished game, if a little linear in the gameplay progression. There's usually only one way to solve any puzzle (no multiple ways around any particular obstacle).

So if you're the tpe to enjoy a roller coaster ride despite the wheels being firmly on-rails at all times, then I think ther'es plenty to love about this game, despite its age. Played in 2026. Recommended
